name: Share unopened consumables between labs
description: Offer surplus unopened reagents and consumables to labs in the same building before ordering new. Feeds directly off the purchase-intercept inventory.

name: Consolidate orders & right-size packs
description: Batch lab orders to a weekly cycle and pick pack sizes that match actual consumption instead of catalogue defaults.

name: Green-chemistry supplier substitution
description: Switch to reformulated or lower-carbon suppliers where protocols allow. Capped low because research continuity comes first.

name: Reusable labware substitution
description: Replace single-use plastic labware with autoclavable glass or reusable alternatives where protocols allow.

name: Bulk packaging & pack-size right-sizing
description: Buy labware in bulk packaging to cut per-unit packaging material and inbound shipments.

name: Validated tip & plate wash-and-reuse
description: Validated washing programme for pipette tips and plates in non-sterile workflows. High effort because each protocol needs sign-off.

name: Cylinder right-sizing & leak reduction
description: Reduce cylinder turnover and fix regulator and line leaks. The single largest carbon category on campus purchasing.

name: On-demand nitrogen generation
description: Replace delivered liquid nitrogen with on-site generation in the highest-use buildings, cutting boil-off and delivery volume.

name: Shared cylinder pool per building
description: Pool cylinders across labs in a building so idle full cylinders are used before new ones are ordered.

name: Reagent sharing & cold-chain batching
description: Batch orders to cut shipments, share enzymes/kits via core facilities before expiry.

name: Shared instrumentation cores
description: Route duplicate instrument purchases to shared research cores; buy serviced/refurbished instruments.

name: Extend refresh cycle & buy refurbished
description: Extend laptop refresh from 4 to 5 years and buy a share as certified refurbished. Saves money and carbon; the cheapest lever available.

name: License rationalisation
description: Reclaim unused seats and consolidate overlapping products at renewal.

name: Campus surplus (SWAP) first
description: Check campus surplus before new office orders; standardise on a shorter catalogue.

name: Default duplex & digital-first workflows
description: Duplex-by-default printing and digital forms; recycled-content paper on contract.

name: Refurbished & SWAP furniture
description: Source from campus surplus and refurbished lines at renewal or move-in. Large ceiling because furniture is highly reusable.

name: Consolidated MRO & repair-first
description: Repair-first policy and consolidated weekly MRO deliveries per building.

name: Travel policy & virtual-first
description: Virtual-first for short meetings, rail for regional trips, cap per-unit travel budgets.

name: Consolidate inbound shipments
description: Weekly consolidated deliveries per building instead of per-order shipping; drop expedited by default.

name: Closed-loop helium recapture
description: Helium recovery and re-liquefaction on NMR and cryogenic systems, which recapture the large majority of boil-off. Capital-intensive with a multi-year payback, so it cannot be stood up by 2030.

name: Low-carbon gas supply contract
description: Contract air-separation supply from renewable-powered plants. Cuts the emission factor itself rather than the volume, so it stacks on top of the usage levers.

name: Supplier decarbonisation requirements
description: Write product-carbon-footprint disclosure and absolute reduction targets into reagent and consumable contracts at renewal. Depends on the supplier market maturing.

name: Green chemistry protocol redesign
description: Redesign high-volume teaching and screening protocols around benign solvents and micro-scale methods. Needs curriculum and methods revalidation.

name: Closed-loop labware take-back
description: Vendor take-back and closed-loop recycling for sterile plastics, plus recycled-content resin specifications on contract.

name: Bio-based resin substitution
description: Bio-based and recycled-content labware wherever sterility and chemical compatibility allow. Gated on supplier qualification.

name: Supplier PCF targets at renewal
description: Require product carbon footprints and reduction commitments from pharmaceutical and biologics suppliers at contract renewal.

name: Instrument lifetime extension programme
description: Funded service, calibration and parts programme that pushes instrument lifetimes well past warranty instead of replacing.

name: Supplier PCF targets & device-as-a-service
description: Device-as-a-service with guaranteed refurbishment and take-back, plus supplier carbon targets in the standard laptop contract.

name: Carbon-aware cloud procurement
description: Region and vendor selection weighted by grid carbon intensity; efficiency clauses in cloud and SaaS renewals.

name: Supplier take-back & refill standards
description: Refill-first standards and vendor take-back for consumables, written into the office supplies contract.

name: Paperless-by-default systems
description: Retire paper-based administrative workflows at the system level rather than relying on individual printing behaviour.

name: Circular furniture contracts
description: Lease-and-return and remanufacture-to-order furniture contracts that keep material in service indefinitely.

name: Circular MRO & supplier targets
description: Remanufactured parts as the default and carbon reduction targets in MRO supply agreements.

name: Sustainable aviation fuel & rail-first
description: SAF certificate purchasing for unavoidable travel plus a hard rail-first rule for regional trips. Expensive per tonne and dependent on SAF supply.

name: Electrified last-mile & logistics targets
description: Electrified campus last-mile delivery and carbon targets in freight contracts.
